integrity: All mathematical details and standalone exact-rational verification are included. Existing authors and general lemmas are attributed; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns single-site positional voter weak-selection derivatives on finite unweighted loopless trees. It does not prove an all-bias ranking, and the global coalescence formula is pre-existing. The sharp finite tree-order classification is supported by an exact exhaustive Prüfer certificate for every smaller order; independent publication priority has not been certified.
title: The first strict degree-first failure in weak positional voter fixation on trees has nine vertices
